nodes.summary: For each natural number $n$ let $r_{n,0}, \dots, r_{n,n-1}$ be non-negative real numbers, and let $a(n,k)$ be the coefficient of $x^k$ in the real polynomial $A_n(x) = \prod_{i\lt n} (x + r_{n,i})$. Put $\mu_n = \sum_{i\lt n} 1/(1 + r_{n,i})$ and $\sigma_n^2 = \sum_{i\lt n} r_{n,i}/(1 + r_{n,i})^2$, and let $\sigma_n \ge 0$ be the square root of $\sigma_n^2$. Then for every $n$,…
nodes.title: Bender's central limit theorem for polynomials with non-positive real zeros

nodes.summary: Let $N_{n,k}$ be the coefficient of $x^k$ in the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n(x)$, and let $\sigma_n = \sqrt{(n^2 - n - 2)/(8(n - 1))}$. Then for every real $x$, the sum of the coefficients $N_{n,k}$ over $0 \le k < n$ with $k \le n/2 + x \sigma_n$, divided by $N_n(1)$, tends to $\Phi(x)$ as $n \to \infty$, where $\Phi$ is the distribution function of the standard normal distribution.
nodes.title: Asymptotic normality of the coefficients of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $N_{n,k}$ be the coefficient of $x^k$ in the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n(x)$. For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, $N_{n,k-1} N_{n,k+1} \le N_{n,k}^2$, where for $k = 0$ the index $k - 1$ is read as $0$.
nodes.title: Log-concavity of the coefficients of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $N_{n,k}$ be the coefficient of $x^k$ in the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n(x)$. The infinite real matrix $[N_{n,k}]_{n,k \ge 1}$, whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$ ($i, j \ge 0$) is $N_{i+1,j+1}$, has nonnegative minors: every square submatrix obtained by choosing finitely many rows and finitely many columns, each in increasing order, has nonnegative determinant.
nodes.title: Total positivity of the coefficient matrix of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n$ satisfies the identity of polynomials with rational coefficients $16x\, N_n(x^2) = 2(n+1)x \bigl((1+x)^{2n} + (1-x)^{2n}\bigr) - \bigl((1+x)^{2n+2} - (1-x)^{2n+2}\bigr)$.
nodes.title: Binomial closed form of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: For all real numbers $x$ and $z$ with $x \ne 0$, the series $\sum_{n \ge 0} N_n(x^2)\, z^n / n!$ built from the type-A minuscule polynomials $N_n$ has sum $\frac{2x(1+x)^2 z - 1 - x^2}{16x} e^{(1+x)^2 z} + \frac{2x(1-x)^2 z + 1 + x^2}{16x} e^{(1-x)^2 z}$.
nodes.title: Exponential generating function of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: For every integer $n \ge 1$, the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n$ satisfies $N_n(1) = (n - 1)\, 2^{2n-3}$.
nodes.title: Bourn–Erickson formula for the minuscule polynomials at one

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ there are non-negative integers $\gamma_{n,0}, \dots, \gamma_{n,\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$ such that the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n$ satisfies $N_n(x) = \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor} \gamma_{n,k}\, x^k (1 + x)^{n-2k}$.
nodes.title: Gamma-positivity of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$. There are nonzero real numbers $c, d$ and real numbers $r_0 \le \dots \le r_{n-1}$ and $s_0 \le \dots \le s_{n-2}$ such that the type-A minuscule polynomials factor over $\mathbb{R}$ as $N_{n+1}(x) = c \prod_{i=0}^{n-1} (x - r_i)$ and $N_n(x) = d \prod_{j=0}^{n-2} (x - s_j)$, and $r_j \le s_j \le r_{j+1}$ for every $j$ with $0 \le j \le n - 2$.
nodes.title: Interlacing of consecutive minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n$, viewed as a complex polynomial, is real-rooted: every element of its multiset of roots is real.
nodes.title: Real-rootedness of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: The type-A minuscule polynomial $N_1(x)$ is the zero polynomial.
nodes.title: The minuscule polynomial $N_1$ vanishes

nodes.summary: Let $N_n$ denote the type-A minuscule polynomial. For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the coefficient of $x^k$ in $N_n(x)^2 - N_{n+1}(x) N_{n-1}(x)$ is non-negative, where $N_{n-1}$ is read as $N_0$ when $n = 0$.
nodes.title: $x$-log-concavity of the minuscule polynomials

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the type-A minuscule polynomial $N_n(x)$ is the polynomial with rational coefficients

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
